claim_boundary.not_permitted: Manufacturer-certified absolute robot accuracy, accredited dimensional metrology, force sensing, arbitrary payloads or generalization beyond these 15 conditions.
claim_boundary.paper_disclosure: The 0.75-mm C and 1.0-mm H/R allowances are pretrial engineering bounds derived from retained ruler-scale cross-checks and deliberate upward rounding; they are not manufacturer specifications. All raw readings, actual-state minima and limitations must be reported.
claim_boundary.permitted: Prospectively residual-adjusted model/telemetry evidence under the fixed robot, meshes, physical marks, payload/resource identities and observer rules in this package.

common_rules.actual_joint_tracking: evaluated by actual-state FCL and reported directly; never double-subtracted from the same actual-state distance
common_rules.backend_numeric: included inside each rounded family residual rather than added as a hidden extra term
common_rules.controller: 0.09-rad first-point acceptance, 0.10-rad path tolerance and 0.12-rad goal tolerance are distinct; controller success never overrides a geometry or observer failure
common_rules.sample_interval: host gap must be <=25 ms; every retained endpoint plus 0.01-rad dense interpolation is checked; any incomplete coverage is UNKNOWN
common_rules.scene_change: any reassembly, changed link shell, changed support, changed object identity or unplanned obstacle invalidates the bound before send

C.pass_precondition: the live-matched full desired transition and each actual-state trace must independently retain >10 mm after this fixed deduction

H.object_pose_rule: the five 34..36-mm sender and 58..62-mm receiver variants are explicit screened sets; physical marks and categorical video bind placement instead of adding an unmeasured 6-DoF claim

R.object_pose_rule: the 75x75x45-mm foam and all +/-3-mm placements remain inside the already screened conservative 90x90x50-mm world envelope; categorical fixed video verifies support and containment

review_projection_note: Historical pre-start status fields are retained as campaign metadata; final outcomes are recorded under results/final-revalidation/c115/.
